music.prompt: Small shadow-puppet theatre ensemble, percussion first: low barrel drum, hard woodblock clapper, small hand gongs, and a nasal bowed two-string fiddle playing a stern, modal, slightly sorrowful melody. Slow processional pulse around 70 bpm, tension growing steadily; in the last four seconds the drum accelerates into a roll and then thins to almost nothing.

Night, hushed and reverent: a solo bamboo flute playing a few long, sparse pentatonic phrases over a very soft low drone, lots of space and silence between notes, intimate small-room reverb, no percussion.

The shadow-theatre ensemble returns in full and swells into an awe-filled, hopeful march: a big gong on the downbeat, frame drums and barrel drum at a steady walking tempo, bowed fiddle and bamboo flute in warm unison over them, rising in brightness, then settling gently onto a long resolved chord at the end.

sfx.prompt: Oil lamp being lit behind a cloth screen: a soft whoomp of flame and a small sizzle
Single deep bronze gong strike with a long shimmering decay
A sudden chorus of many frogs croaking, short and dry
Hailstones pattering and bouncing hard on dry ground, short burst
Oil lamps guttering and going out, quick fluttering flames then a soft pfft and sizzle
A deep, slow, low wind passing high overhead from right to left, a dark whoosh that rises and fades away
Big gong crash together with oil lamps flaring up all at once
Great waters rushing apart and rising into walls, a deep roaring surge of the sea that settles into a low rumble
